# 109 — Configuration_Loading

Reports that an attempt to obtain a configuration candidate is beginning\.

[All events](index.md) · [Configuration category](Category_Configuration.md) · [API reference](xref:Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents.ConfigurationEvents.Loading%28System.String%2CSystem.String%2CSystem.String%29)

| Introduced | Unpublished |

## Usage

Import `Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents`. This example assumes an existing
`ILogger` named `logger` and caller-supplied variables for the arguments.

```csharp
logger.Configuration.Loading(@configurationName, @sourceName, @loadId);
```

**Trigger:** Emit immediately before beginning source access, reading, parsing, or deserialization for a configuration\-loading attempt\.

**Message template:** Loading configuration\. Configuration: \{ConfigurationName\}\. Source: \{SourceName\}\. Load: \{LoadId\}\.

## Arguments

- `configurationName` (`string`): The non\-sensitive logical name of the configuration being loaded\.
- `sourceName` (`string`): The non\-sensitive logical source name\. Do not include credentials, connection strings, or sensitive paths or addresses\.
- `loadId` (`string`): The unique identifier of this loading attempt\. Use a new identifier for each retry or reload\.

## Remarks

- Use the same ConfigurationName, SourceName, and LoadId for the beginning and outcome of one loading attempt\.
- A successfully obtained candidate is reported through Configuration\_Loaded\. A required loading attempt that fails before obtaining a candidate is reported through Configuration\_LoadFailed\.
- Cancellation, process termination, filtering, or collection loss can leave a beginning record without an observed outcome\. A missing outcome does not by itself prove failure\.
- A missing optional source is not automatically a loading failure\. If no candidate is obtained, do not report Configuration\_Loaded merely because the absence is acceptable\.
- LoadId identifies a loading attempt\. ValidationId identifies a validation attempt\. Use a logging scope or trace when correlation across these phases is required\.
- Names must be non\-sensitive\. The library does not redact caller\-supplied text\.
- Calling this method only emits a diagnostic record\. It does not load configuration, start a timer, retain attempt state, or emit an outcome automatically\.
